# Velopass

> Velopass is a bike registration and anti-theft service: one Frame-ID sticker on your bike gives access to theft protection, roadside assistance, insurance and your bike shop.

Velopass provides Frame-ID stickers and an online registry so owners can prove ownership and report theft, and buyers can check a bike before buying second-hand. Frame-IDs are available across Europe; partner bike shops are active in Belgium, the Netherlands and France. In Belgium Velopass is linked to MyBike; in France Velopass is an approved APIC operator with registration in the national FNUCI file. The site is available in English, Dutch, French, German and Spanish (EN, NL, FR, DE, ES).

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.velopass.com/en): Order a Frame-ID sticker and protect your bike.
- [Order](https://www.velopass.com/en/order): Order Frame-ID bundles (Solo, Duo, Family).
- [Bike Check](https://www.velopass.com/en/bike-check): Check if a bike is registered or reported stolen before buying.
- [Report Stolen](https://www.velopass.com/en/stolen): What to do when your bike is stolen, per country.
- [For bike shops](https://www.velopass.com/en/shop): B2B page for bike shops: sign up for free, mark bikes with Frame-IDs and build lasting customer relationships.
- [Professionals](https://www.velopass.com/en/pro): Overview for professional partners.
- [Manufacturers](https://www.velopass.com/en/manufacturer): Partnerships for OEM frame registration.
- [Insurance](https://www.velopass.com/en/insurance): How insurers use Velopass.
- [Leasing](https://www.velopass.com/en/leasing): Fleet registration for bike leasing companies.
- [Assistance](https://www.velopass.com/en/assistance): Roadside assistance linked to your Frame-ID.
- [Contact](https://www.velopass.com/en/contact): Get in touch with the Velopass team.
- [Buying Second-Hand Guide](https://www.velopass.com/en/guides/buying-second-hand): Checklist to safely buy a used bike.
- [Marquage vélo (FR)](https://www.velopass.com/fr/marquage-velo): For French bike shops: become an approved bike-marking point (APIC/FNUCI, loi LOM).
